start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:report-progress with database <the name of my own account database>, key <a name for the work>, title <what it says> and state running."
no_lists_because: Work still going on is a row of the person's own database; this workflow keeps it there and names no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Name the database your account keeps its rows in.

2. Say "Run workflow:report-progress" with database, key and title each time the work moves; add done and total counts, a unit, a body and a source when there are any, and state done or failed when it ends.
3. Reporting again under the same key changes the same card; the end is told once as a notice your devices read.
4. Each run answers the work cards too; a card not reported for ten minutes (or quiet_minutes) reads as stopped.

worked_examples.title: Show a drive copy and tell me when it ends
worked_examples.ask: Show me that the drive copy is at 60 of 100.
worked_examples.given: The progress table holds no row under copy:1, or one at 10 of 100.
worked_examples.hands_back: key copy:1, state running, told false. The same call with state done and done 100 hands back state done, told true; sent again, told false.
